description: Every integration test cites an external oracle: openssl verify (lines 895, 930, 1073, 1348), pyca/cryptography (lines 1223, 1247, 1453), or RFC normative references (line 1178). All fixtures are committed binary artifacts (.der files), not generated from code under test. This breaks the test oracle trap: encrypt-with-A, decrypt-with-A proves nothing. Regression test comments (lines 987-998, 1026-1035, 1030-1035) document prior bugs each test prevented, enabling future maintainers to understand test value.
title: Decision: Test oracle independence with external fixtures
